name: Проклятие! Проклятая шмотка
alt: Проклятый шлем вцепился в деревянный манекен и не желает сниматься.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky forms, strong silhouette. Centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, not copied card art. Clear plausible anatomy, no unintended extra limbs. Subject: One purple steel helmet covered in a few harmless curled black magical tendrils, firmly stuck on a plain wooden display head. Two gloved hands on two slender wooden mannequin arms try unsuccessfully to lift the helmet by its sides, head itself has a comically unhappy carved face. Clear connected display bust, no other limbs. Violet sparks and a tiny ghostly padlock hovering above helmet convey magical locking.
